answer:
They get an HTML `page` artifact on the project's own CSS, instead of a plugin-driven live sheet.

How it was settled: I first asked you the Angular/webpack/custom-server question, and you answered "What cawco plugin now?" I then decided the fallback myself when you had only asked for an explanation, and you called that out: "Why did you decide the fallback on your own when I just asked for explanation?" I re-asked, and you replied: "Just use ur own canvas with some html or json or whatever? Cmon".

So the HTML `page` artifact is my reading of that answer, and I noted it as my call. It's recorded in the PRD (D29 and §5.10, commit cdd94a2a4) and in §10 of the live-components spec.
